import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_76/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_76/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source0 and Source1 on 'city'
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1[['city', 'fare']], on='city', how='inner')

# Group by city and type, aggregate average fare
grouped = joined.groupby(['city', 'type'], as_index=False)['fare'].mean()

# Ensure column types match target schema
grouped['city'] = grouped['city'].astype(str)
grouped['type'] = grouped['type'].astype(str)
grouped['fare'] = grouped['fare'].astype(float)

# Rename to target table name (optional, here just assign)
Target3_76 = grouped

# Write to the specified output path without index
Target3_76.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_76/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_76/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on city (inner join to keep only matching cities)
